{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm deduplication worked
print('After deduplication: number of patients =', len(df_dedup))
print('Expected: 800 (848 total - 48 duplicate rows)')

# Check the distribution of severity in the deduplicated data
severity_counts = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print('\nFraction of patients with severe baseline disease:', severity_counts.get('severe', 0))"}
